SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.activity_id, v.id AS venue_id, v.name AS venue_name, v.venue_type, v.city, v.district, v.address, s.start_at, s.end_at, s.price, s.remaining_seats, s.status, s.registration_url, v.price_note FROM activity_session s JOIN venue v ON v.id = s.venue_id AND v.active = 1 WHERE s.activity_id = #{activityId} AND s.status IN ('OPEN', 'FULL')
AND s.start_at >= #{date} AND s.start_at < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY CASE s.status WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.start_at ASC, s.remaining_seats DESC
SELECT DISTINCT activity_id FROM activity_session WHERE activity_id IN #{id}
